patch_properties.axis_order: Depth, Height, Width (PyTorch standard C x D x H x W)

grouping_limitation_declaration: Splits are strictly grouped by SeriesInstanceUID. In LIDC-IDRI, this prevents scan-level leakage for co-occurring nodules. In rare cases where one patient underwent multiple distinct scan series, patient-level cross-scan correlation is possible due to absence of explicit PatientID tags in this pre-extracted patch metadata.
